name: weight_add_weight_pairMap
statement: ℕ} (t : Finset σ × σ) (h : t ∈ pairs σ k) : weight σ R k t + weight σ R k (pairMap σ t) = 0

name: sum_filter_pairs_eq_sum_powersetCard_mem_filter_antidiagonal_sum
statement: ℕ) (a : ℕ × ℕ) (ha : a ∈ {a ∈ antidiagonal k | a.fst < k}) (f : Finset σ × σ → MvPolynomial σ R) : ∑ t ∈ pairs σ k with #t.1 = a.1, f t = ∑ A ∈ powersetCard a.1 univ, ∑ j, f (A, j)

name: psum_eq_mul_esymm_sub_sum
statement: ℕ) (h : 0 < k) : psum σ R k = (-1) ^ (k + 1) * k * esymm σ R k - ∑ a ∈ antidiagonal k with a.1 ∈ Set.Ioo 0 k, (-1) ^ a.fst * esymm σ R a.1 * psum σ R a.2
